matched_negatives.why: Negatives sampled >1 km from positives are systematically less urban (impervious 0.24 vs 0.83), so imperviousness alone scores ROC-AUC 0.867. Re-scoring on imperviousness-matched negatives removes that shortcut; what survives is hydrological skill rather than an urban/rural artifact.

honesty_note: WITHIN-EVENT AUC is the number that matters for the product's ward-ranking claim. Coordinates were excluded as features to prevent memorising the 84 label locations. Two independent measurements (Phase 2 gate, label enrichment 0.94) already showed static terrain does not explain where Delhi floods.
